decision_description: Phase 2 concept refinement is complete and the project concept for 'Uncertainty-aware multi-sensor diagnosis and water-use-efficient irrigation decision support for tomato' (Dr. Rositsa Cholakova, ELTE Budapest, MSCA-PF European Fellowship, 24 months) is confirmed as aligned with the HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 call. All eight expected outcomes (EO-01 through EO-08) have been mapped to the concept corpus with full traceability to Tier 2B sources and Tier 3 evidence. Scope coverage assessment confirms that all mandatory scope requirements applicable to this European Fellowship (SR-01, SR-02, SR-03, SR-05, SR-07) are covered; SR-06 is partially covered (citizen science not explicitly addressed, recorded as a non-blocking gap for Phase 8 remedy); SR-04 and all Global Fellowship, secondment, and non-academic placement constraints (CC-03 to CC-10) are explicitly not applicable to this European Fellowship configuration. The scope_conflict_log is empty: zero tier conflicts were found between the concept and Tier 2B sources. The topic_mapping.json has been written to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/call_binding/ covering all eight EO mappings. Four research-methodology claims in the prior scope-check entry (thematic domain, AquaCrop methodology, validation protocol and TRL target, AgroVIR associated-partner role) were flagged as unable to be affirmatively confirmed against specific Tier 2B scope boundary entries; this determination is resolved here as consistent with the instrument because MSCA-PF is discipline-agnostic by design and no Tier 2B scope_requirements.json or call_constraints.json entry excludes or restricts the proposal's research domain, methodology, or TRL target. These items are not scope contradictions and do not constitute unresolved conflicts under CLAUDE.md §7. The EO-04 mapping (European Charter for Researchers working conditions alignment) carries Assumed status reflecting an instrument-level host obligation not requiring explicit concept-level treatment; this assumption is explicitly declared per CLAUDE.md §12.2. The strategic differentiation narrative is confirmed: research novelty is grounded in a documented research-gap matrix identifying the Real-Time Decision Support × PlanetScope empty cell and the underdeveloped end-to-end coupling of learned multimodal fusion, probabilistic crop-water-state estimation, and WUE-oriented irrigation optimisation; researcher-and-host differentiation is confirmed by the genuine two-way knowledge transfer between Dr. Cholakova's plant physiology and non-destructive stress-phenotyping expertise and ELTE ICG's geoinformatics and multisensor-fusion competences under Dr. András Jung. CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition is satisfied: topic mapping confirmed, concept vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes, strategic positioning identifies proposal differentiation within call scope, and no unresolved scope conflicts remain.
alternatives_considered: Declaring the four flagged research-methodology scope-check items as 'unresolved conflicts' requiring operator intervention before gate passage — rejected because MSCA-PF defines no thematic research domain constraints in Tier 2B; the flagged items arise from the discipline-agnostic nature of the instrument, not from contradictions between tier sources. CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition requires absence of 'unresolved scope conflicts between the concept and Tier 2B'; a flagged item that is not contradicted by any Tier 2B entry and arises from the instrument's discipline-agnostic design does not constitute a scope conflict.

Recording EO-04 (European Charter for Researchers working conditions alignment) as 'Unresolved' requiring explicit operator confirmation before proceeding — considered but rejected because ELTE's Charter alignment is a mandatory instrument-level host obligation imposed on all MSCA-PF beneficiaries by the programme framework, not a project-specific design choice; recording it as Assumed with explicit declaration satisfies CLAUDE.md §12.2 without fabricating project-specific coverage that does not exist in the concept corpus.

Blocking Phase 2 gate passage on the SR-06 citizen science partial coverage gap — rejected because SR-06 partial coverage does not constitute an unresolved scope conflict; the scope_conflict_log is empty, and the gap is a proposal strengthening opportunity to be addressed at Phase 8 drafting, not a blocking gate condition under CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2.
tier_authority_applied: Tier 2B docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json (SR-01 to SR-11, sourced from HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json); Tier 2B docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/expected_outcomes.json (EO-01 to EO-08, sourced from HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json); Tier 2B docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/call_constraints.json (CC-01 to CC-18, sourced from HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json); CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition (topic mapping confirmed; concept vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes; strategic positioning identifies differentiation; no unresolved scope conflicts between concept and Tier 2B); CLAUDE.md §12.2 (validation status categories: Confirmed, Inferred, Assumed, Unresolved — governs EO-04 Assumed disposition and SR-06 partially_covered status)
rationale: All eight MSCA-PF expected outcomes (EO-01 to EO-08) are mapped with specific Tier 2B source section references and Tier 3 evidence references tracing to concept_note.md and strategic_positioning.md artifacts in docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/. EO-01, EO-05, and EO-07 are Confirmed with direct evidence. EO-02, EO-03, EO-06, and EO-08 are Inferred with substantive evidence chains explicitly stated. EO-04 is Assumed under instrument-level host obligation with the assumption explicitly declared per CLAUDE.md §12.2. All mandatory scope requirements applicable to a European Fellowship are covered. The four research-methodology claims flagged in the prior scope-check entry (topic-scope-check_0401295c.json) are resolved here as non-conflicting: they reflect the discipline-agnostic design of MSCA-PF. No Tier 2B source document entry contradicts the proposal's thematic domain (crop water stress, irrigation decision support), methodology (probabilistic machine learning, AquaCrop, multi-sensor fusion), validation approach (non-destructive physiological ground truth, prediction-interval coverage), TRL target (3–4), or associated-partner engagement model (AgroVIR field access). The SR-06 citizen science gap is a real partial coverage finding, non-blocking because partially_covered is not an unresolved conflict and the scope_conflict_log contains zero entries. The CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition requires: (1) topic mapping confirmed — YES, topic_mapping.json written to Tier 3 call_binding covering all EO-01 to EO-08; (2) concept note vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes — YES, all eight outcome mappings carry Tier 3 evidence references with call vocabulary reflected in concept_note.md; (3) strategic positioning identifies proposal differentiation within call scope — YES, research-gap matrix differentiation and genuine two-way knowledge transfer confirmed with specific evidence; (4) no unresolved scope conflicts between concept and Tier 2B — YES, scope_conflict_log is empty and all flagged items are resolved as consistent with the instrument's discipline-agnostic scope design. Gate condition is satisfied and this decision is recorded as durable per CLAUDE.md §9.4.
